## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `chore: ...`); it becomes the squash commit and drives the version and changelog
- [ ] Linked the OpenSpec change (`openspec/changes/<name>`), if this is a feature or behavior change
- [ ] Updated `.claude/rules/cicd.md` if this changes a workflow, required check or release procedure
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or `.env` contents in the diff
